每个点，只是算了一次公式: Each point is just one evaluation of the formula
右边是参数方程。粒子编号 i 与时间 t 代进去，就得到一个平面坐标 (x, y: On the right are the parametric equations. Plug in particle index i and time t to get a plane point (x, y). No texture, no hand-drawn outline—the silhouette is spat out by the formula alone.
距离项 d：把点拧出“厚度”: Distance term d: twist thickness into the cloud
k 与 e 先各自用 cos 算出，再取 √(k²+e²) 得到 d。这一步像量: k and e are each built from cos, then d = √(k²+e²). Like measuring a radius: far points are pushed out, near points pack into a ridge—so the creature gains volume.
时间 t：公式开始呼吸: Time t: the formula starts to breathe
t 每帧往前走一点点，套在 sin/cos 里。同一串 i 的落点随之缓慢移动，: t advances a little each frame inside sin/cos. The same indices shift with it, so the image keeps changing.
公式骨架不变，只改振幅与频率：水母、脊骨、丝带。数学上这叫同一参数族里的不同成员: The skeleton of the formula stays; only amplitudes and frequencies change: jellyfish, spine, ribbon. In math terms these are members of one parametric family—very different shapes, one rule.
轮到你：改形变，转相位: Your turn: reshape it, turn the phase
自由探索时可以拧形变/密度，或拖动画布弯折相位。记住：画面再怪，也只是 i 与: In free explore, scrub morph/density or drag the canvas to bend phase. However strange the image looks, it is only i and t plugged into the formula—that is the math behind generative art.
